title: NFL Week 10 Recap: Chargers' First Win, Mahomes 5 TDs, 49ers Win 46–40 Shootout & Bills 8–1 🏈
description:
Everything you missed from NFL Week 10: the Los Angeles Chargers beat the Baltimore Ravens 23–20 on Monday Night Football for their first win of the season, Patrick Mahomes threw five touchdown passes in Atlanta, the San Francisco 49ers beat the Dallas Cowboys 46–40, Joe Burrow threw for 409 yards as the Cincinnati Bengals beat the Pittsburgh Steelers, the Detroit Lions won in Munich and the Buffalo Bills moved to 8–1 for the first time since 1991. Plus every result, the playoff picture and the Week 11 games to watch.

NFL scores, standings and live scores: https://scorebuzz.net

#NFL #NFLWeek10 #Chargers #49ers #BillsMafia
